scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
I am the festival NPC manager for the God SE quest.
Please enter your password.
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
我是二代神器任務的慶典NPC管理員。
請輸入密碼。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Password is incorrect.
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
密碼錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
您想要做什麼？

scripts.text: Disable festival NPCs
scripts.translation: 停用慶典NPC

scripts.text: Enable festival NPCs
scripts.translation: 啟用慶典NPC

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Ending festivals and disabling NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
正在結束慶典並停用NPC。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Resetting festivals and enabling NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
正在重置慶典並啟用NPC。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
This is the flower.
This is just a formality, but let me check your qualifications.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
就是這朵花。
雖然只是例行公事，還是讓我確認一下你的資格。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Your qualification is verified as a Guild master.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
已確認，你是公會會長。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I wonder if you know what this flower's use is... Let me explain it to you.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
不知道你是否瞭解這朵花的用途...讓我解釋一下。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
This is the holy flower given by the Wish Maiden in Valkyrie, it can summon certain monsters by certain summoners.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
這是戰乙女祈望女神賜予的聖花，特定的召喚師可以用它召喚特定的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
There are only two summoners in this world...
Me and my sister Rhehe...
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
這個世界上只有兩位召喚師...
我和我的妹妹雷赫...

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
We are totllly different, but we can...
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
我們完全不同，但是我們可以...

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Anyway,
Do you want to summon monsters?
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
總之，你想召喚魔物嗎？

scripts.text: Do not summon
scripts.translation: 不召喚

scripts.text: Summon, please
scripts.translation: 請召喚

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I don't like to be interrupted by others..
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
我不喜歡被別人打斷...

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
But it's just business.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
但這只是公事。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I will explain to you how to summon monsters.
This flower can summon the monsters 'Valkyrie's Blessing' and 'Valkyrie's Present' for one hour here in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
我來向你解釋如何召喚魔物。
這朵花可以在朱諾召喚“瓦爾基里的賜福”和“瓦爾基里的禮物”魔物，持續一小時。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
An announcement will be made stating which monster is summoned.
This festival is given by the Wish maiden for all adventurers to enjoy all over the world.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
屆時會發布公告，說明召喚的是哪種魔物。
這是祈望女神為全世界冒險者準備的慶典，讓大家一起盡興。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Now, are you ready to summon monsters?
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
那麼，你準備好召喚魔物了嗎？

scripts.text: No, I'm not ready now.
scripts.translation: 還沒準備好

scripts.text: Yes! I'm ready for that.
scripts.translation: 準備好了

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
If you are not ready, why did you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
如果你還沒準備好，為什麼還要來找我？

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I'll be waiting until you are ready.
It is just business afterall.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
我會等你準備好的。
畢竟這只是公事。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Now we are ready.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
現在，我們準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Ok, we would ge started to summon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
好的，我們要開始召喚魔物了。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
祝你玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
It seems that a Valkyrie's Blessing summoning ritual is already in progress elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
似乎其他地方已經有人在進行“瓦爾基里的賜福”召喚儀式了。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Please try again later.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
請稍後再試。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
It seems you are not worthy.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
看來你並不具備資格。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I don't know how you obtained that flower, but if you're not capable of leading others.. then you cannot continue.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
我不知道你是怎麼得到那朵花的，但如果你沒有能力領導他人...那你就無法繼續了。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Too tough?
Well, what can you do, that's part of the job.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
太難了嗎？
唉，沒辦法，這也是工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Don't you have any voucher?
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
你沒有憑證嗎？

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
I am the festival NPC manager for the God SE quest.
Please enter your password.
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
我是二代神器任務的慶典NPC管理員。
請輸入密碼。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Password is incorrect.
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
密碼錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
您想要做什麼？

scripts.text: Disable festival NPCs
scripts.translation: 停用慶典NPC

scripts.text: Enable festival NPCs
scripts.translation: 啟用慶典NPC

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Ending festivals and disabling NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
正在結束慶典並停用NPC。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Resetting festivals and enabling NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[慶典管理員]
正在重置慶典並啟用NPC。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
A flower!!
Shall we proceed?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
是花！！
我們開始吧？

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Eeeeh, so young and yet you're a guild master? Your guildsmen must be jealous.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
哎呀，這麼年輕就是公會會長了？你的公會成員一定很羨慕吧。

scripts.text:
[Reumimi Ravies]
I'm not sure if you understand the uses for that flower, so I'll briefly explain.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
不知道你是否瞭解那朵花的用途，我就簡單說明一下。

scripts.text:
[Reumimi Ravies]
That flower has been passed down as a gift from the Valkyrie Wish Maiden herself.
It may be used to summon special monsters through summoners in special areas.
scripts.translation:
[爾米米·拉維斯]
那朵花是戰乙女祈望女神親自贈送的禮物。
召喚師可以用它在特定區域召喚特殊魔物。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
There are only two summoners in existence who are capable of using that flower.
One is me, and the other is my twin sister Reumimi.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
世界上只有兩位召喚師能使用那朵花。
一個是我，另一個是我的雙胞胎姐姐爾米米。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Twin sisters, but we do not have much alike, little fingers in front of you ...
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
雖然是雙胞胎姐妹，但我們長得一點都不像，你看我伸出的小指...

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
..................................
.....Oops! I wasn't supposed to tell anyone...

[Rhehe Ravies]
... Hehehe, anyways let's move on.
So do you wish to summon or not!?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
... Hehehe，總之，繼續說正事吧。
你到底要不要召喚！？

scripts.text: Do not summon
scripts.translation: 不召喚

scripts.text: Summon
scripts.translation: 召喚

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
...*Cries*.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
...*哭泣*。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
If you've got no business with me, please don't start a conversation.
If it were my sister, she would've humiliated you for it.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
如果你沒有正事，請不要跟我搭話。
要是我姐姐聽到，肯定會讓你難堪的。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Okay then, I'll explain a little about the summoning ritual.
Here in Juno, the summoning ritual through the use of that flower will summon Valkyrie's Blessing and Valkyrie's Gift.
The effects of the summoning ritual will last approximately one hour.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
好，那我簡單介紹一下召喚儀式。
在朱諾，用這朵花進行儀式，就能召喚出“瓦爾基里的賜福”和“瓦爾基里的禮物”。
召喚效果大約會持續一個小時。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
During the summoning ritual, continuous broadcasts will be made.
It is a courtesy of the Valkyrie Wish Maiden, in order to unite adventurers from all over to participate in the festival.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
召喚儀式期間會持續釋出廣播。
這是戰乙女祈望女神的一番心意，希望各地冒險者一起參加慶典。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Are you ready to begin the summoning ritual~?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
你準備好開始召喚儀式了嗎~？

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒準備好

scripts.text: Yes! I'm ready!
scripts.translation: 準備好了

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
You're not even ready, why bother talking to me?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
你還沒準備好，為什麼還要來找我？

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Oh well, if you've got other things to do then I'll wait.
After all, that's also part of my job.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
好吧，如果你還有其他事要做，我就等著。
畢竟，這也是我工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Very well, then I will check for a reasonable time to begin the summoning ritual.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
好，那我看看現在是否適合開始召喚儀式。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Good! Now seems like a good time, so let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
太好了！現在似乎是個好時機，我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
I hope you enjoy yourself!
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
祝你玩得盡興！

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
*Cries*
It doesn't seem like now is a good time.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
*哭泣*
看來現在不是個好時機。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Please try again later.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
請稍後再試。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
...Seems like you're not in a worthy position for me to talk to?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
...看來你還沒有資格讓我跟你說話？

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
I don't know how you obtained that flower, but if you're not capable of leading others.. then you cannot continue.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
我不知道你是怎麼得到那朵花的，但如果你沒有能力領導他人...那你就不能繼續了。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Too tough?
Well, what can you do, that's part of the job.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
太苛刻了嗎？
唉，沒辦法，這也是工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Don't you have anything to give me to prove yourself?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉維斯]
你難道就沒有什麼能證明自己的東西嗎？
